description.value: Presotea is a Taiwanese bubble tea franchise established in 2006, now operating multiple Lower Mainland locations including this Metrotown branch on Kingsway. The shop specialises in freshly brewed teas made using a high-pressure espresso-style machine, offering an extensive menu of milk teas, fruit teas, and slushes. It is a takeout-only counter with no indoor or outdoor seating.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (covered) at 78m; rack at 87m.
